title: mutations/M-NNN.mutation.json
description: One controlled mutation (AD-8). It is the single source of the qualification's mutationSource, targetArtifact, operator and expectedObservableFailure. tea-evaluate check refuses an operator other than replace-exact with exactly one occurrence, and a targetArtifact inside a provisioned directory, under their own rules.

mutationSource.description: Where the mutation came from, in the author's terms.

targetArtifact.description: The mutated file, relative to the target's root, in POSIX form, with no drive letter, no "." or ".." segment, no empty segment or trailing slash, and no control character (C0, DEL or C1), a line or paragraph separator, or a bidirectional formatting character.
